images.prompt: Keeper of Hours — STARTER identity master, v5. A YOUNG WOMAN, early twenties — read unmistakably as a woman in face and build: a smooth, softly rounded chin with NO cleft and NO dimple, a soft jawline, feminine features, slender neck, a woman's proportions under practical clothing — dark curly hair tied back, sun-browned skin, face fully visible, no helmet, a calm practical archivist's bearing. One full-body figure, facing the camera (direction S), projection C (elevated three-quarter), standing, feet visible, weight even, arms relaxed, a plain wooden staff held upright in the RIGHT hand. Costume (every item is an instrument or carries one): ivory linen shirt with rolled sleeves under a navy wool sleeveless tabard whose chest is PLAIN — no emblem, no ring, no shape of any kind; ONE chestnut leather harness strap running from the right shoulder diagonally to the LEFT hip where it carries an olive waxed-canvas satchel with brass corners; ONE chestnut leather waist belt whose buckle closes the tabard; chestnut leather laced bracers on both forearms; navy wool trousers; chestnut leather buckled boots. Staff: a plain dark walnut shaft with small brass ferrules at the foot and the tip — NO ring, NO head-piece, NO shape atop it. NO insignia anywhere on the character: every surface is plain and undecorated — no trim, no edge ornament, no sigils, no compass diagrams, no studs. Register: FLAT INK-AND-WASH 2D — clean uniform ink outline, flat colour fills with at most one wash of shadow, no painted texture, no gradients, muted palette, graphic and minimal; a frame of hand-drawn cel animation. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on the key-facing edge; no spell glow; NO floor shadow. Flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas; do not matte.
